description: This file defines an Android activity class 'AdsCatalogActivity' that manages a view pager displaying multiple ad fragments. It includes inner classes for pager management and individual ad display fragments, handling ad loading, display, and callbacks using AdMob SDK.

classes.name: AdsCatalogActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing a view pager that displays different ad example fragments.

classes.name: AdsCatalogActivity.PagerAdapter
classes.description: Adapter managing fragments within the view pager, providing ad fragments based on position.

classes.name: AdsCatalogActivity.AdFragment
classes.description: Fragment representing an individual ad display, inflates layout, loads ads, and handles ad callbacks.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the view pager with the adapter.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, specifically navigation to the first page.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns a new ad fragment instance for the specified position.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of ad items.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new AdFragment instance with a specified index.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up fragment state, retrieves its index from arguments.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the appropriate layout for the ad fragment, initializes ad view, starts loading ad.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up ad view when fragment is destroyed.
